name: io.github.cbetz/last-ehr
title: Last EHR — Medplum
description: FHIR chart tools for MCP: read-only by default, with elicitation-gated, human-approved writes.

environmentVariables.name: MEDPLUM_ACCESS_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: FHIR chart tools over Medplum or a local HAPI stack: read-only by default, with an opt-in elicitation-gated write profile (human-approved per action).

environmentVariables.name: MEDPLUM_CLIENT_ID
environmentVariables.description: FHIR chart tools over Medplum or a local HAPI stack: read-only by default, with an opt-in elicitation-gated write profile (human-approved per action).

environmentVariables.name: MEDPLUM_CLIENT_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: FHIR chart tools over Medplum or a local HAPI stack: read-only by default, with an opt-in elicitation-gated write profile (human-approved per action).

environmentVariables.name: MEDPLUM_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: FHIR chart tools over Medplum or a local HAPI stack: read-only by default, with an opt-in elicitation-gated write profile (human-approved per action).

environmentVariables.name: LASTEHR_BACKEND
environmentVariables.description: epic, oracle, or smart. Requires LASTEHR_EXPERIMENTAL_FHIR_ADAPTERS=1. Sandbox writes are approval-gated and persist because those sandboxes do not support delete.

environmentVariables.name: LASTEHR_EXPERIMENTAL_FHIR_ADAPTERS
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to enable LASTEHR_BACKEND epic, oracle, or smart.

environmentVariables.name: LASTEHR_CLIENT_ID
environmentVariables.description: SMART Backend Services client id. Not a secret.

environmentVariables.name: LASTEHR_PRIVATE_KEY
environmentVariables.description: PKCS#8 PEM for SMART private_key_jwt. Never log it.

environmentVariables.name: LASTEHR_PRIVATE_KEY_PATH
environmentVariables.description: Path to the PKCS#8 PEM. Alternative to LASTEHR_PRIVATE_KEY.

environmentVariables.name: LASTEHR_KEY_ID
environmentVariables.description: JWT kid. Must match the public JWKS.

environmentVariables.name: LASTEHR_JWKS_URL
environmentVariables.description: https URL of the public JWKS. doctor checks that LASTEHR_KEY_ID is present. Optional.

environmentVariables.name: LASTEHR_SCOPES
environmentVariables.description: Space-delimited SMART scopes. Required for Oracle. Omit for Epic unless overriding the app registration.

environmentVariables.name: LASTEHR_FHIR_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: FHIR base URL. Epic and Oracle default to their public sandboxes when unset.

environmentVariables.name: LASTEHR_TOKEN_URL
environmentVariables.description: SMART token URL. Epic and Oracle default to their public sandboxes when unset.

environmentVariables.name: LASTEHR_ENCOUNTER
environmentVariables.description: Encounter/{id} added to Epic observations when the tool call omits encounter.

environmentVariables.name: LASTEHR_PERFORMER
environmentVariables.description: Practitioner/{id} filed as legal authenticator on Oracle observations.
